select jest.*, je.display_name as employeeName, je.bank_card_no as bankCardNo, je.bank_name as bankName, je.employee_number as employeeNumber, je.employee_type as employeeType from employee_salary_temp jest inner join employee je on jest.employee_id = je.id and je.deleted = 'n' and je.book_id = #{dto.bookId}
and je.display_name like CONCAT('%', #{dto.employeeName}, '%')
and je.employee_number like CONCAT('%', #{dto.employeeNumber}, '%')
where jest.deleted = 'n' and jest.belong_date = #{dto.currentYearMonth} and jest.book_id = #{dto.bookId} order by jest.created_date desc
